replacements.new:
session_reference (non-secret)

provider_session_id (non-secret)

engineeringFindings.finding: QR bearer в URL и поле qr_token не определяют защиту секрета.

replacements.new: qr_token_digest (SHA-256 of a 32-byte cryptographically random secret; plaintext token is returned once and never stored or logged)

POST /qr-resolve

replacements.new:
## Level 1 — Public

No personal or medical fields are public by default. P0 requires explicit, scoped, time-limited consent before a bearer QR holder can receive one snapshot. Identity, blood group and emergency-contact data may only be included in an explicitly selected profile scope. Recipient profession is not verified by possession of a QR.

engineeringFindings.finding: Безусловные old_value/new_value дублируют медицинские сведения в audit.

replacements.new:
changed_field_names (allowlisted identifiers only; no medical values)

resource_version_before

resource_version_after

Never log medical payloads, documents, tokens, cookies or QR secrets. Audit captures action, outcome, actor/resource references and request ID; clinical version history, if needed, is a separate protected data store.

engineeringFindings.finding: Zero Data Loss не совместимо с ненулевым RPO и не подтверждено тестом.

replacements.new: • Measured data-loss bound: proposed pilot RPO ≤24 hours and RTO ≤8 hours; verify by an independent restore before pilot. The original ≤5-minute RPO / ≤15-minute RTO remains an unvalidated future target, not a zero-data-loss guarantee.

engineeringFindings.finding: PostgreSQL сам по себе не доказывает transparent data encryption.

replacements.new: • Select and verify encryption at rest for the actual database service/storage and backups, with separate managed keys, access controls and tested recovery. PostgreSQL selection alone does not demonstrate Transparent Data Encryption.

engineeringFindings.finding: Сроки 7/10 лет и Permanent Archive не имеют обоснования.

replacements.old:
Operational Logs

90 Days

Audit Logs

7 Years

Security Events

10 Years

Critical Incidents

replacements.new: Retention must be purpose- and jurisdiction-specific, with named owner, deletion procedure and approved exceptions. Original 90-day / 7-year / 10-year / permanent values are unvalidated proposals, not universal requirements. Proposed pilot baseline: 30-day technical logs without medical content; 90-day minimal access audit; 30-day encrypted backup horizon. Resolve applicable obligations before processing real data; see docs/engineering/operations.md.

engineeringFindings.finding: Перечень сервисов не отличает модульные границы P0 от раздельных сервисов.

replacements.new:
# Backend Layer

P0 decision: one modular application plus worker from the same codebase, PostgreSQL and private object storage. The service names below describe logical/future capabilities, not deployed microservices. Module 51 modular-monolith MVP takes precedence; P0 excludes AI, travel, telemedicine and institutional integration. See docs/engineering/architecture.md.

engineeringFindings.finding: Поля таблиц не задают обязательность, FK, owner isolation, units, null semantics, concurrency.

replacements.new:
# Standard Columns

P0 normative data rules: one profile per owner; medical resources reference profile_id and never accept an independent client owner ID. Use UTC timestamptz for events, calendar date for dates, integer resource versions with If-Match, enforced foreign keys and ownership checks. Distinguish unknown allergy status from none_known. See docs/engineering/data-model.md and specs/openapi.json.

engineeringFindings.finding: Endpoint-список не определяет usable schemas, scopes, pagination, token lifecycle или ошибки.

replacements.new: • Proposed OpenAPI 3.1.1 P0 contract: specs/openapi.json. This is a specification, not an implemented or deployed API. Legacy endpoint lists below are roadmap items; the P0 contract explicitly supersedes them for supported operations.

# Registration

P0 decision: registration, authentication, MFA and recovery are delegated to a selected OIDC provider using Authorization Code + PKCE. The custom endpoint catalogue below is retained as historical planning, not the P0 API. EDHT validates access tokens, provider session status and local account state. No server upload of biometric templates. See docs/engineering/auth-and-qr.md.

engineeringFindings.finding: is_verified не различает antivirus, authenticity и клиническую верификацию.

replacements.new: file_safety_state (quarantined / available / rejected / deleted; malware scanning does not verify clinical content or issuer authenticity)

replacements.new: • Permanent Access — excluded from P0; P0 grants require explicit scoped consent, 60–86 400-second expiry, atomic one-time use and revocation. No offline or emergency override grants in P0.
